Hymn 82: For All the Saints
Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 82 titled "For All the Saints" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ralph Vaughan Williams and the lyrics were written by William W. How.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
